title: DataNet WC Review Criteria Hold v1
summary: Public criteria describing how future DataNet availability work packets may be evaluated. This is criteria-only and does not perform intake, review approval, WC issuance, ledger mutation, VOID allocation, payment handling, or runtime mutation.

criteria.title: Public-safe evidence only
criteria.requirement: Evidence must avoid private DataNet object material, private content roots, private object IDs, participant identifiers, reviewer identifiers, and operator identifiers.

criteria.title: Availability claim shape
criteria.requirement: A future packet should describe the claimed DataNet availability work type, claimed capability, public-safe route or observation reference, and review window.

criteria.title: Reviewer verifiability
criteria.requirement: A reviewer should be able to inspect the public-safe evidence without needing secrets, wallet access, signer access, private object material, or runtime mutation.

criteria.title: Duplicate reward prevention
criteria.requirement: A future review process should check whether the same claim has already been evaluated before any future WC lane action is considered.

criteria.title: Manual hold boundary
criteria.requirement: Criteria publication alone must not trigger intake, approval, WC issuance, ledger write, VOID allocation, payment handling, or execution.
